top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a defined physical invention: trapping-shift control makes confined atoms usable as a spectroscopic reference, opening new access to time and gravity without claiming a new gravitational law. Katori and Ye plausibly unite conception and decisive realization, but their early-history, enabling-metrology and independent-systematic dossier remains outstanding. The specific Cole/Percival problem leaves the discussed BAO allocation unjustified and it is not on this slate. I next favor QSH's phase prediction meeting nature, then DMFT's dynamical explanation and exact fluctuation/work relations with their unresolved Seifert boundary. All are substantial bounded achievements, so no award is last; matching preferences and compact names do not establish priority.
